title: Tough Letter
summary: Read to unlock a Nine-Fingers dialogue option with Bugthimble.

fields.Read: Reading adds a response in the Lower City graveyard encounter. A DC 18 Intimidation check using Nine-Fingers’ name makes Bugthimble flee. A follow-up DC 25 Intimidation demand can obtain Kurwin’s Cauteriser before she leaves.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
